meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 运行 /update-skills 后，Claude 会检查代码仓库是否干净，列出已安装的 channel 和 provider 技能，让你挑选要更新的项，然后逐个重新运行它们自带的安装步骤，从上游拉取最新代码覆盖旧文件，最后执行构建和测试来验证。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中发出 /update-skills 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills，更新所有已安装的技能。
say.note: 会弹出选择列表让你勾选要更新的技能。

say.text: 只重新应用 Slack 技能。
say.note: 会调用 /add-slack 从上游拉取最新代码。

say.text: 跳过本次更新，不修改任何技能。
say.note: 对应选择 Skip 选项，直接结束流程。

howto.what_en: Running /update-skills makes Claude check for a clean working tree, list installed channel and provider skills, let you pick which to re-apply, then re-run each skill's own apply step to fetch latest code from upstream and overwrite old files, followed by build and test validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-skills in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills.
say_en.note: A selection list will appear for you to choose.
Calls /add-slack to fetch latest code from upstream.

say_en.text: Skip this update and change nothing.
say_en.note: Picks the Skip option and ends the flow.
